example.rule: test discharges of V1 re-partition r2 (folds k0-k4), >= 500 rows in the S set (L5), >= 3 absent steps (15 ms < step < 45 ms inside a segment); median of the skill of TX over T0 under S on the discharge's scored rows (lower median for an even count); second example = 25th percentile (index floor(0.25 (n - 1)) of the sorted skills)

window_rule: three 2 s windows centred at the 25, 50 and 75 % quantiles of the times of the discharge's scored rows
